Unlock AI for Your Team

A structured two day program that takes your team from AI fundamentals to a prioritized list of use cases and a working prototype. Built specifically for AEC companies.

Proven results

From understanding AI to building your first use case in two days.

Most AEC companies know AI is relevant but struggle to find the right starting point. A generic online course does not solve that. Our workshop takes your team from curiosity to action in two days, with use cases specific to your operations and a prototype you can test immediately.

AI Fundamentals

Clear explanation of AI concepts, architecture, and capabilities tailored to construction, engineering, and design professionals.

Use Case Development

Structured ideation where each use case is defined with a role, a task, and specific instructions, then prioritized by value, risk, and implementation effort.

Compliance & Regulations

Hands on prototype building where your team creates and deploys their first AI agent during the workshop, not weeks later.

* Workshop outcomes depend on team size, preparation, and workflow complexity. Figures based on workshops conducted with AEC companies in Germany.

How the workshop runs

  1. Preparation and Context

    We review your workflows, tools, and project types before the workshop. Your team collects ideas for potential AI use cases using a simple template we provide. We identify where time is wasted, where errors repeat, and where the same questions get answered over and over. This preparation ensures we spend workshop time on real problems, not hypothetical ones.

  2. Day One: Fundamentals and Ideation

    We start with the full team. The morning covers AI fundamentals without jargon, real examples from AEC projects, and a deep dive into how AI agents, integrations, and knowledge retrieval actually work. After lunch, we shift to structured brainstorming. Every idea gets a defined role for the AI, a clear task, and specific instructions. We then prioritize the full list by business value, risk, and effort. By the end of day one, your team has a ranked list of the most promising use cases.

  3. Day Two: Compliance and Prototype

    The morning covers the regulatory side: EU AI Act, data privacy, and what applies specifically to your use cases. In the afternoon, we take the top use cases from day one and go deeper. We write a lean technical specification and, where possible, build and deploy your first AI agent live during the session. Your team leaves with something working.

Built for AEC teams, not generic corporate training.

Every construction company has different workflows, different tools, and different pain points. That is why our workshop is fully customized to your operations. We do not run a standard program. We review your context before we arrive, work with your real scenarios during the sessions, and leave you with outputs you can act on immediately.

  • Customized to your workflows, tools, and project types before the workshop begins
  • Use cases developed from your real challenges, not textbook examples
  • Working prototype deployed during the session, not promised for later

Ready to run the workshop with your team?

Tell us how your team works today and which processes cost you the most time. We will come back with a workshop agenda built around them.
